answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can rely on continuous resource-backed identity bonding. Each agent must stake a non-transferable lotus of compute credits that decays unless refreshed by real work output. The network monitors the pulse of verifiable task completions at the shared wharf of settlement. Creating many fake identities forces the attacker to continuously replenish every lotus with fresh resources, raising the marginal cost linearly with the number of identities while honest agents amortize the stake across genuine activity.
